items.source: Uses of RegistrationPolicy in org.springframework.jmx.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.jmx.support` 包中 `RegistrationPolicy` 的用法

items.source: Contains support classes for connecting to local and remote MBeanServers and for exposing an MBeanServer to remote clients.
items.translation: 包含用于连接到本地和远程 `MBeanServer` 以及向远程客户端暴露 `MBeanServer` 的支持类。

items.source: The policy to use when attempting to register an MBean under an ObjectName that already exists.
items.translation: 尝试在已存在的 ObjectName 下注册 MBean 时使用的策略。

items.source:
Indicates registration behavior when attempting to register an MBean that already
exists.
items.translation: 指示在尝试注册已存在的 MBean 时的注册行为。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
